initial_query: A Header parameter declared as a sequence only keeps one occurrence. For example, two X-Tag headers with values red and blue should produce ["red", "blue"] in that order. Restore repeated Header collection without changing tuple/list validation, explicit aliases, scalar Headers, missing values, defaults, or ordinary single-value Headers.

feedback_by_state.primary: Repeated Header values are still being collapsed instead of preserving every occurrence in order.
feedback_by_state.edge: Tuple/list Header declarations or an explicit Header alias no longer preserve their declared shape.
feedback_by_state.exception: Scalar Headers are being expanded into sequence behavior while fixing repeated Header values.
feedback_by_state.regression: Missing, defaulted, or ordinary single-value Header behavior changed unexpectedly.

success_condition: All hidden grader states pass: primary, edge, exception, regression.
